message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (per 9‑x‑13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (≈ 450 g) |
| | Italian sausage (optional) | ½ lb (≈ 225 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (≈ 800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Red wine (optional) | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh basil, chopped | 1 Tbsp |
| | Oregano (dried) | 1 tsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| **Ricotta Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (≈ 425 g) |
| | Egg (for binding) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Mozzarella Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 4 cups (≈ 400 g) |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (sautéed, drained) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms (sautéed) | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |
| | Zucchini, grated | ½ cup |

**Tips:**
- If using regular lasagna sheets, pre‑cook them in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water.
- For a richer flavor, brown the meat and sausage before adding tomatoes.
- Mix the ricotta mixture with the egg and Parmesan to help it set during baking.
- Layer: start with a thin layer of sauce at the bottom, then pasta, ricotta, mozzarella, sauce, repeat, finishing with sauce and a generous topping of mozzarella and Parmesan.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
